idea-plugin.name: Sergeant
idea-plugin.description: Sergeant is a model-free evidence-based engineering reviewer with a complete Command Center for missions, permanent officers, armoury, evidence, reports, doctrine, permissions, roadmap, and guidance. The JetBrains preview runs the shared Sergeant CLI against the current project. One model or a bounded multi-model council is available only as explicit owner-enabled extra reasoning, while Sergeant remains final authority and writer actions remain human-approved.

action.description: Run Sergeant's model-free review against the current project
